mapper.insert: INSERT INTO som_sales_store (store_id, tenant_id, platform, store_code, store_name, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{tenantId}, #{platform}, #{storeCode}, #{storeName}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT store_id, tenant_id, platform, store_code, store_name, status, created_at, updated_at FROM som_sales_store WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
